title: Statistics & data-viz -- where it stands
thesis: The compute core is genuinely careful -- SIMD Neumaier summation, engine hypothesis tests that never return a bare p-value, and a chart pipeline byte-tested against captured ground truth. But this is not yet scipy.stats or R: nonparametric tests, resampling and time-series are absent, half the analyst's chart types don't render, and the exploratory (Tukey) tier is a plan with no code. A strong foundation, honestly incomplete.

lanes.note: Full descriptive set over lane-parallel Neumaier compensated summation (@Vector(8), measured 2.5x); at parity and numerically more careful than most.
Three backends per chart; renderers guarded byte-identical against captured ground truth (107 parity assertions), 19 SVG/PNG checks with no GPU.
lanes.proof: plot.zig; 107 parity assertions + 19 deviceless SVG/PNG checks

lanes.note: t-tests, chi-square, one-way ANOVA, Pearson test each return statistic, df, p-value, effect size and a conclusion; the nonparametric family is missing.
PCA, t-SNE/UMAP, k-means, kNN, naive Bayes, ID3, logistic regression, FFT, eigen-solver over a 15 GFLOP/s matmul; shallower than scikit-learn.
stzDataSet (211 methods): CIs, five-number stats, contingency, entropy, mutual information, insights/rules/plans; stzDataWrangler is pure Haro.
Real LP/MIP: Big-M tableau simplex in the engine, branch-and-bound, stochastic/robust solver, root/quadrature, LU/Gauss-Jordan.
CDF and quantile for Normal, Student-t, Chi-square, F only; no discrete distributions (binomial, Poisson), no distribution object.
Pearson/Spearman, covariance, simple linear regression engine-backed; no multiple regression, GLM, logistic-as-stats or ridge/lasso.
Bar, histogram, scatter, treemap render across all three backends; box, violin, pie/donut, heatmap, area, radar, contour all missing.
random.zig ships seeded sampling and shuffles but no bootstrap CI, permutation test or jackknife is built on it.
Moving average is an engine primitive, trend is Haro-side; no autocorrelation, seasonality, exponential smoothing or ARIMA.
A detailed plan of record (TK0-TK6) with no code shipped: no eda.zig, no faces, no test/tukey/.

standouts: Hypothesis tests never return a bare p-value: effect size and a conclusion with every one
Chart renderers byte-tested against captured ground truth (107 parity assertions)
Three backends per chart: engine terminal, deviceless SVG, GPU PNG
gaps: Nonparametric and normality tests (Mann-Whitney, Kruskal-Wallis, KS, Shapiro-Wilk)
The statistical chart family (box, violin, pie/donut, heatmap, area)
Bootstrap CI and permutation test over the existing sampler
Multiple regression, GLM and diagnostics; a real time-series lane; the unbuilt Tukey tier
